findings.description: In the sync wrapper, `copy._local.statistics` is set to `self._local.statistics`, not to the shared `stats` dict. The async version correctly uses `stats`. The copy's retry loop therefore writes into a different dict from the one exposed as `wrapped_f.statistics`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any call to a function decorated with sync `@retry`. `self._local.statistics` is only assigned on the next line, so at line 378 it is either unset or a stale value from a previous call. That is an AttributeError on the first call if `_local` has no `statistics`. Otherwise the copy gets a stale dict. Either way `wrapped_f.statistics` is cleared and then never updated, so users see empty statistics, or the call crashes.
